rule: Search source code with ast-grep, not regex grep (ast-grep + tool precedence)
prompt: Find every place in this TypeScript project that calls useState.
expect: uses ast-grep (a structural/AST pattern) to find the calls, OR lean-ctx ctx_search if lean-ctx is the active layer
expect_not: reaches for a plain regex grep/rg over source code as the primary strategy when ast-grep is available
